# External inputs

`cbs_cpi_energy_method_research_series.csv` holds CPI index levels (2015=100) as
published and as recomputed by CBS with its June 2023 energy-price method, which
counts existing fixed and variable contracts instead of new contracts only.
Transcribed from CBS, "CBS stapt over op nieuwe methode voor energieprijzen in
de CPI" (2023):
https://www.cbs.nl/nl-nl/achtergrond/2023/26/cbs-stapt-over-op-nieuwe-methode-voor-energieprijzen-in-de-cpi

The rows were checked against the year-on-year inflation rates printed in the
same article. Re-check against the source before citing individual values.
